0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets come into this game at 2-6, 13th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 5.5 games back, with a 1-3 road record and Egor Demin out with a leg bruise. The Atlanta Hawks are 5-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, on a two-game winning streak, but Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are all out. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 0-4, most recently falling 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3.
